about: Part attack's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row attack, 'Inputs and outputs'; docs/game-parts/attack.md). Places beyond gameroutine.py's are read by tools/native/gparts/checkpos.py's place() (gw: glayout's tic GW fields; cp: a label of the part's image: attack.s exports its scratch block's places AK_*), which tools/native/gparts/attack.py uses. P_LineAttack takes t1, the angle, the distance as upstream's _Dp[0-3], X:C, _Dp[4-7] and the slope and the damage on the stack (S + 4, S + 8 at the JSL's entry), natively GA_0-1, GA_2-5, GA_6-9, GA_10-13, GA_14-15. P_AimLineAttack takes t1, the angle, the distance the same way and returns X:C, natively GA_0-3; linetarget (upstream's _g_linetarget) is the shared GM_LINETARGET (request R1, wave 5 as integrated). The near scratch of p_attack65.s that lives from one call to the next is compared as outputs: aimslope (an aim that finds no target keeps the last one: an input too), la_damage (P_AimLineAttack keeps it), attackrange (GM_ATRANGE, read by P_IsAttackRangeMeleeRange), shootz, shootthing, and the aim's topslope, bottomslope and linetarget (P_AimLineAttack's; P_LineAttack leaves them).
